title: Relief Grooves for Grinding Zones and Threads
rules: Relief grooves for grinding zones must follow UNI4386 standard comparison guidelines
Relief grooves for thread must be made in cases where the thread zone ends at a shoulder with ledge function
Groove dimensions vary by pitch (P) and diameter range
Specific grooves must be indicated in details of drawing
Four diameter ranges defined for grinding relief: 18-50mm, 51-80mm, 81-125mm, >125mm
dimensions: Grinding relief 18-50mm: width 2.5mm, depth 0.4mm, radius R 0.1
Grinding relief 51-80mm: width 3mm, depth 0.8mm, radius R 1.6
Grinding relief 81-125mm: width 4.5mm, depth 2.9mm, radius R 2.5
Grinding relief >125mm: width 7mm, depth 5mm, radius R4.0
tolerances: Thread relief radii: 3.2° angular tolerance shown on groove profile
inspection: Relief groove dimensions must be verified per drawing specifications
Groove profile conformance to UNI standard or TRASMITAL specifications
Radius and angular features must be checked
manufacturing_notes: Relief grooves facilitate grinding operations by providing tool clearance
Thread relief grooves prevent interference at shoulder transitions
TRASMITAL specifications may override UNI regulation where applicable
Grooves are size-dependent: larger diameters require wider and deeper grooves
30° angle specified for grinding relief groove sides
training_guidance: NX agent must select relief groove dimensions based on shaft diameter range for grinding zones
For threaded features ending at shoulders, automatically insert thread relief groove based on pitch (P)
Use UNI4386 as baseline standard with TRASMITAL overrides when specified
Apply correct tolerances from tables: tighter for smaller diameters, looser for larger
Thread relief groove depth formula: approximately P × 0.613±3
Model 30° draft angle on grinding relief groove walls
Always detail specific groove dimensions on engineering drawings
Relief grooves are mandatory manufacturing features, not optional
summary: This page defines two critical relief groove standards: TAB-001 for grinding zones and TAB-002 for threaded areas. Grinding relief dimensions are specified across four diameter ranges (18-50mm to >125mm) with corresponding widths, depths, radii, and tolerances per UNI4386. Thread relief grooves are sized by pitch (P<1.25 to P=2.5-3) and must be provided where threads terminate at shoulders to prevent interference. All groove geometries must be explicitly detailed on manufacturing drawings.
